fixes_2026_10_06.title: controlled direct gateway had no pre-send asset-revocation check
fixes_2026_10_06.issue: the direct ModelGateway.complete attempt loop wrote the snapshot and asset records, then went straight to start_attempt -> network. Only the routed gateway checked assets. A bundle revoked after attempt 1 was still sent on attempt 2, and the routed refusal path left the invocation RUNNING.
fixes_2026_10_06.fix: added shared ModelControlStore.assert_request_active(invocation_id, context) (bound invocation + owner + bundle; does not re-resolve latest stable/learning policy; not installed when no Learning service is configured). The direct gateway calls it after on_attempt_started and before start_attempt, and on failure calls finish_invocation(handle, 'failed') then re-raises (no retry, no fallback, zero network, snapshot unchanged). The routed gateway's inline checks were replaced by the same method and its refusal path now finishes the invocation.

fixes_2026_10_06.title: the real compiler's JSON repair reused the original execution span
fixes_2026_10_06.issue: GoalProgramCompiler._validated reused the ambient ModelCallContext for both complete() calls; with the same purpose, child_call_context did not create a new span, so the repair call looked like a retry of the first call (2 invocations, 2 snapshots, only 1 distinct span).
fixes_2026_10_06.fix: added model_control.new_logical_call(context, *, role, purpose) which derives an independent logical call (new span/invocation/snapshot) from the PARENT context, inheriting owner/trace/budget/bundle/task and clearing invocation_id/idempotency_key/input_snapshot_id/context_snapshot_digest; without a harness it falls back to replace(). _validated reads parent = self._parent_context() once and derives sibling spans from that same parent on every iteration. goal_programs._model_context no longer pre-derives a child span. Added read-only current_call_context(); when there is no parent the call omits the context= argument so the legacy standalone entry point keeps its exact old call shape.
fixes_2026_10_06.after_result: S01-S05 pass; redacted sample chain-sample/chain-compile.md shows the two spans both hanging off the root span, same trace, different snapshots, and the first logical call's 2 attempts sharing one invocation and one request_digest

fixes_2026_10_06.title: idempotency identity comparison was incomplete without a harness
fixes_2026_10_06.issue: _execution_identity_digest returned None without a harness and _resolve_existing_invocation only compared execution digests when BOTH sides were non-null, and did not compare run/thread/turn/task/root_budget field by field. The same key with the same input but run_id A -> B was still judged a replay.
fixes_2026_10_06.before_symptom: the second call raised InvocationReplayError where InvocationIdempotencyConflict was expected
fixes_2026_10_06.fix: added _IDENTITY_COLUMNS (owner_id, run_id, thread_id, turn_id, agent_task_id, root_budget_id, runtime_bundle_id; agent_task_id is the harness task_id). _existing_invocation now SELECTs those columns. _resolve_existing_invocation compares them field by field (including nulls) plus role/purpose, and keeps the request_digest and context_snapshot_digest comparisons. Added _execution_identity_conflicts: a one-sided harness is always refused as a replay, and when both sides carry a harness the execution_context_digest is compared too.
fixes_2026_10_06.after_result: K01-K06 pass (K05/K06 on isolated PostgreSQL when Docker was up)

fixes_2026_10_07.title: a refused response dropped its already-billed usage
fixes_2026_10_07.issue: when the post-response asset check refused a response, the routed gateway passed None to finish_attempt instead of the response it had just received. The provider had already run and already billed that attempt, but the known token usage was written as empty (usage_status UNAVAILABLE) and cost settlement could not use the real usage.

environment_limited_tests.root_cause: the test hardcodes lease_seconds=0.2, but on this machine the worker spends 190-340 ms between claim_next() and the first _assert_job_owner() (a single sqlite connection + SELECT 1 costs 100-186 ms here). The lease is already stale when ownership is first asserted, _process exits through TurnJobLeaseLost, and the model is never called.

environment_limited_tests.isolation: same test passes when the only change is lease_seconds 0.2 -> 30 (not a repository change; measured in a scratch script). The Phase 2A diff does not touch claim_next, _assert_job_owner, _heartbeat, _process or TurnJobLeaseLost.
